requirements.title: A persistent index directory in the library
requirements.rationale: A caller that runs one process per call must be able to keep the index where the next process finds it, without changing anything for an embedder that does not ask.

criteria.action: keep the index in a run directory under TempDir that Close deletes, as before this package
criteria.contract: after Close, the run directory and the per-workspace directory under TempDir are gone and nothing was written anywhere else

check.pseudocode: in codesearch/index_test.go: TestCloseWaitsForTheFirstBuildAndRemovesItsRunDirectory and TestShardsLiveInARunDirectoryPerIndex keep passing unchanged with the zero IndexDir

criteria.condition: Options.IndexDir is set and a build completes
criteria.action: store the index under <IndexDir>/agentkit-codesearch-<sha256 of the workspace root>/: the shards, the indexed files, the outlines, each file's size, modification time, indexing time and content hash, the build statistics and the partial flag and reason, with a manifest naming the workspace root and the format version, and keep it on Close
criteria.contract: after a code_search and Close, the per-workspace directory holds the manifest and the shards; two workspaces sharing one IndexDir get two directories, each with its own root in its manifest

setup: two temporary workspaces A and B and one temporary IndexDir, outside both
check.pseudocode: in codesearch/index_test.go, a new test beside TestShardsLiveInARunDirectoryPerIndex: for ws in {A, B}: idx = indexFor(t, ws, {IndexDir: D}); find(t, idx, 'needle'); idx.Close(); dir = D/agentkit-codesearch-<sha256(ws.Root())>; assert dir holds a manifest naming ws.Root() and the format version, and at least one shard; assert the two directories differ

criteria.condition: Options.IndexDir is the workspace root or lies inside it, after resolving the symbolic links of the parts that exist
criteria.action: refuse to create the index, touching no disk
criteria.contract: New returns a nil tools.Index and an error saying the index directory must be outside the workspace; nothing is created

check.pseudocode: in codesearch/index_test.go, beside TestNewRefusesANilWorkspaceWithANilInterface, a table over IndexDir in {root, root/sub, root/missing/deeper, a symlink outside that points into root}: idx, err = New(ws, {IndexDir: d}); assert idx == nil (the interface itself); assert err mentions 'outside'; assert the tree under root is unchanged and d/missing was not created

criteria.action: for any build that stores an index, make it visible only when complete, by writing it under a temporary name in the per-workspace directory and renaming it into place over the previous one
criteria.contract: while a build is between writing its shards and storing, the per-workspace directory holds no manifest for it and a loader finds no index; after the rename the manifest and shards are present and no temporary name remains

setup: a test hook that blocks a build after its shards are written and before the rename
check.pseudocode: in codesearch/index_test.go: start a code_search on idx with IndexDir D; when the hook fires, assert the per-workspace directory has no complete index (the load function reports none) and only temporary names; release; after the call, assert the manifest exists and no temporary name is left

criteria.condition: the index directory cannot be created or written
criteria.action: use the build from a run directory under TempDir for the process, store nothing, and answer as usual
criteria.contract: code_search is ok: true with the same files as without IndexDir and no field it would not otherwise carry; nothing is written under IndexDir

setup: skipped as root and on Windows
check.pseudocode: in codesearch/index_test.go, a table over IndexDir in {a path below a regular file, a directory with mode 0500}: idx = indexFor(t, ws, {IndexDir: d, TempDir: T}); r = find(t, idx, 'needle'); assert r.OK and paths(r) == the paths without IndexDir; assert r.Data has the same keys; assert idx.RunDir() is under T; assert nothing new under d

requirements.title: Reuse and revalidation in a later process
requirements.rationale: Reuse is only worth having if the answer is the one a fresh build of the current tree would give.

criteria.condition: the first code_search of an Index finds a complete stored index for its workspace root in the current format
criteria.action: load it instead of building, and revalidate the whole tree against it before answering
criteria.contract: BuildCount() is 0 after the query; RevalCount() is at least 1; the result lists the same files as the process that built it

check.pseudocode: in codesearch/tool_test.go, beside TestTheFirstCodeSearchBuildsTheIndexOnce: a = indexFor(t, ws, {IndexDir: D}); ra = find(t, a, 'needle'); a.Close(); b = indexFor(t, ws, {IndexDir: D}); rb = find(t, b, 'needle'); assert b.BuildCount() == 0; assert b.RevalCount() >= 1; assert paths(rb) == paths(ra)

criteria.action: for any set of changes made to the tree between the process that stored the index and a later one (an edit that changes a file's size, one that changes only its modification time, a new file, a deleted file), answer in the later process as a fresh build over the current tree would
criteria.contract: for each query, the later Index's result lists the same files, in the same order, as a new Index without IndexDir built over the same tree

check.pseudocode: in codesearch/dirty_test.go, beside TestRevalidationFindsChangesMadeBehindTheToolsBack, a table over the change kinds of the action (each written with os functions, not through the tools, after a.Close()): b = indexFor(t, ws, {IndexDir: D}); fresh = indexFor(t, ws, {}); for q in the queries that match the changed, new and deleted files: assert paths(find(t, b, q)) == paths(find(t, fresh, q)); assert b.BuildCount() == 0 unless the change set passes the rebuild threshold

criteria.action: compare by content, in a later process too, a file that was indexed within the timestamp granule of its last modification, using a stored content hash that does not depend on the process that wrote it
criteria.contract: an edit that keeps a file's size and modification time, made within the granule after it was indexed, is found by the next process

check.pseudocode: in codesearch/dirty_test.go, beside TestRevalidationInsideTheRacyWindowMarksOnlyRealEdits: write f, index it with a (IndexDir D) at once, a.Close(); rewrite f with same-length content holding 'fresh_marker' and restore its modification time with os.Chtimes; b = indexFor(t, ws, {IndexDir: D}); assert 'f' in paths(find(t, b, 'fresh_marker')); and the stored hash of a file equals the hash function's value for its bytes in a separate call, independent of the process seed

criteria.condition: the per-workspace directory holds no index, an index whose manifest names another root, one written in another format version, or one that cannot be read
criteria.action: build a new index, store it in place of what was there, and answer as for a first build
criteria.contract: BuildCount() is 1; the result is the normal result with no extra field; afterwards the manifest names this root and the current format version

check.pseudocode: in codesearch/index_test.go, a table over the states {empty directory; manifest with another root; manifest with format version + 1; manifest that is not JSON; manifest present and a shard truncated to 0 bytes}: prepare D's per-workspace directory; idx = indexFor(t, ws, {IndexDir: D}); r = find(t, idx, 'needle'); assert r.OK and idx.BuildCount() == 1; assert r.Data's keys are those of any first build; assert the manifest now names ws.Root() and the current version

criteria.condition: a process finds more than five percent of the indexed files changed against a stored index
criteria.action: run the full rebuild it runs today and store its result in place of the stored index
criteria.contract: the rebuild happens once; afterwards the stored manifest is newer and a further process loads the rebuilt index without building

check.pseudocode: in codesearch/tool_test.go, extending TestMoreThanFivePercentDirtyRebuildsTheIndex to IndexDir D: a builds and closes; change more than 5% of the files; b = indexFor(... D); find(t, b, q); assert the rebuild ran once and the stored manifest changed; b.Close(); c = indexFor(... D); find(t, c, q); assert c.BuildCount() == 0

requirements.title: Two processes at once and partial builds
requirements.rationale: A relay may start two calls on one checkout at the same moment, and neither may read a half-written index or build twice.

criteria.condition: two Index values, in one process or in two, need the index of the same workspace in the same IndexDir at once and none is stored
criteria.action: let one build while holding an advisory file lock in the per-workspace directory, and let the other wait for the lock and then load what the first stored
criteria.contract: both results list the same files; the builds of the two add up to 1

check.pseudocode: in codesearch/index_test.go, beside TestCallsBehindTheFirstBuildShareIt: a, b = indexFor(... D) twice over the same ws; run find(t, a, q) and find(t, b, q) concurrently; assert paths equal; assert a.BuildCount() + b.BuildCount() == 1

criteria.condition: the lock is still held when the waiter has waited 1.25 times MaxBuildTime plus 5 seconds
criteria.action: build for itself in its own run directory under TempDir and store nothing
criteria.contract: the waiter's result is ok: true; its BuildCount() is 1; the stored index, and the lock holder, are untouched

setup: a test hook that holds the lock as another builder would, and a wait bound shortened through a test seam so the test does not wait the real bound
check.pseudocode: in codesearch/index_test.go: hold the lock; idx = indexFor(... D); r = find(t, idx, q); assert r.OK and idx.BuildCount() == 1; assert idx.RunDir() is under TempDir; assert the per-workspace directory holds what it held before

criteria.action: release the lock when its holder exits, however it exits
criteria.contract: after a process holding the lock is killed, a new Index takes the lock without waiting the bound

setup: the test binary re-run as a helper process that takes the lock and sleeps; skipped on Windows
check.pseudocode: in codesearch/index_test.go: start the helper (the test binary with a flag in its environment); wait until it holds the lock; kill it with SIGKILL; idx = indexFor(... D, MaxBuildTime: 60s); r = find(t, idx, q) under testutil.Within's bound, far below the 80 s wait; assert r.OK and idx.BuildCount() == 1

criteria.condition: a build that stores its index is stopped by MaxFiles, MaxBytes or MaxBuildTime
criteria.action: store the partial index marked as partial with its reason, serve it in the process that built it as today, and build again in a later process that finds it
criteria.contract: the building process's results carry partial: true and partial_reason; a later Index finds the partial manifest, has BuildCount() == 1, and replaces the stored index

check.pseudocode: in codesearch/index_test.go, extending TestBuildBoundsGiveAPartialIndexThatIsNotRetried to IndexDir D with MaxFiles below the file count: r = find(t, a, q); assert r.Data.partial and r.Data.partial_reason == 'files'; assert the manifest is marked partial; a.Close(); b = indexFor(... D, no bound); find(t, b, q); assert b.BuildCount() == 1 and the manifest is no longer partial

requirements.title: find_symbol from the stored index
requirements.rationale: A single find_symbol call must not build a symbol table when a complete index of the tree is already stored.

criteria.condition: Symbols is called on an Index with a complete stored index and no code_search has run in its process
criteria.action: load and revalidate the stored index without building, and answer from its outlines
criteria.contract: ok is true; the matches equal those an Index that built the index returns; BuildCount() is 0; find_symbol through tools.For returns the same matches as without an index

check.pseudocode: in codesearch/symbols_test.go, extending TestFindSymbolGivesTheSameMatchesThroughTheIndex: a builds with IndexDir D and closes; edit one file to add func Fresh; b = indexFor(... D); ans, ok = b.Symbols(ctx, {Name: 'Fresh'}); assert ok and ans has Fresh in the edited file; assert b.BuildCount() == 0; and find_symbol through tools.For with b as Options.Index returns the matches tools.For without an index returns

criteria.condition: Symbols is called on an Index whose stored index is partial or absent and no code_search has run in its process
criteria.action: decline without building, so find_symbol uses its own table as today
criteria.contract: ok is false, the error is nil and BuildCount() is 0

check.pseudocode: in codesearch/symbols_test.go, extending TestSymbolsDeclinesWhenItCannotAnswerInFull with the cases {IndexDir D empty; D holding a partial stored index}: _, ok, err = idx.Symbols(ctx, q); assert !ok and err == nil and idx.BuildCount() == 0

requirements.title: The command's index directory
requirements.rationale: The relay names the index directory on the command line or in the environment of the process it starts, and must never get an index inside the work it checkpoints.

criteria.condition: a subcommand runs with --index-dir set to a non-empty path, or without it and with AGENTKIT_INDEX_DIR set to a non-empty path
criteria.action: create that directory when it is missing and give it to the index as its IndexDir, the flag winning over the variable
criteria.contract: after a code_search call, the per-workspace directory with its manifest exists under the flag's directory when both are set, and under the variable's when only it is set; a missing directory has been created

check.pseudocode: in cmd/agentkit-tools/index_test.go (new), a table over {flag F only (F missing); variable V only; both F and V; flag '' with V}: run(['call','--dir',D,'--request',R(code_search)] + flags, env); assert exit 0 and res.ok; assert a manifest exists under the expected directory (F, V, F, V) and nothing under the other

criteria.condition: neither --index-dir nor AGENTKIT_INDEX_DIR names a directory
criteria.action: keep the index in a temporary directory that is removed when the process ends
criteria.contract: after a code_search call exits 0, no agentkit-codesearch- directory is left under the process's TMPDIR

check.pseudocode: in cmd/agentkit-tools/index_test.go: run(['call','--dir',D,'--request',R(code_search)], env with TMPDIR=T and no AGENTKIT_INDEX_DIR); assert exit 0 and res.ok; assert no entry of T starts with 'agentkit-codesearch-'

criteria.condition: the index directory is the served directory or lies inside it, after resolving symbolic links
criteria.action: serve nothing and say the index directory must be outside the served directory
criteria.contract: exit 2, nothing on stdout, one line on stderr containing 'outside'; nothing is created under the served directory

check.pseudocode: in cmd/agentkit-tools/index_test.go, a table over {--index-dir D; --index-dir D/.index; AGENTKIT_INDEX_DIR=D/x; --index-dir L where L is a symlink to D/y} x the subcommands {call, tools, mcp}: out = run(...); assert exit 2; assert stdout == ''; assert stderr is one line containing 'outside'; assert D's tree is unchanged

criteria.condition: the index directory cannot be created or written
criteria.action: say so once on stderr, naming the directory, and serve code_search with a temporary index for that process
criteria.contract: exit 0; the code_search result is ok: true; stderr holds exactly one line naming the directory

setup: skipped as root and on Windows
check.pseudocode: in cmd/agentkit-tools/index_test.go, a table over {--index-dir below a regular file; --index-dir a directory with mode 0500}: out = run(['call','--dir',D,'--index-dir',X,'--request',R(code_search)]); assert exit 0 and parse(out.stdout).ok; assert stderr has one line and it contains X

criteria.action: answer a code_search single call that finds a complete index and no changed file, on a generated tree of 10 000 source files, in at most one fifth of the wall time of the single call that built the index on the same machine
criteria.contract: wall time of the second `call` process <= wall time of the first / 5

setup: a generated tree of 10 000 small Go source files
a slow test: skipped under -short, so it runs in make check-release, the owner's run, and never in make check
check.pseudocode: in cmd/agentkit-tools/index_test.go: t1 = wall time of run(['call','--dir',T,'--index-dir',X,'--request',R(code_search 'needle')]); t2 = wall time of the same command again; assert both exit 0 with the same files; assert t2 * 5 <= t1

requirements.title: The stored index documented
requirements.rationale: Steering treats an undocumented option, flag or variable as a regression.

criteria.action: describe the stored index in docs/codesearch.md (layout, manifest, lock, reuse, revalidation, partial builds), codesearch.Options.IndexDir and AGENTKIT_INDEX_DIR in docs/configuration.md, --index-dir and the variable in docs/cli.md, and a relay that names an index directory in docs/guide.md, each Contents index matching its headings, with docs/generated refreshed by make doc
criteria.contract: each of the four documents names what the action lists; `make doc` leaves `git status --porcelain` empty

execution_paths.title: A relay makes two single calls and the second reuses the index

steps.action: writes a code_search request file and runs `agentkit-tools call --dir <checkout> --index-dir <dir> --request <file>`
builds the index, stores it under <dir>, answers and exits 0
loads the stored index, revalidates, answers without building and exits 0

real_components: the agentkit-tools binary, one process per call
setup: a temporary checkout holding needle in a.go, and an empty index directory outside it
the binary built from cmd/agentkit-tools; skipped where codesearch.New returns ErrUnsupported
end_state: both results are ok: true and name the same files, a.go among them
the index directory holds one per-workspace directory with a manifest naming the checkout
the manifest's bytes and modification time, and the shards', are unchanged by the second call
smoke.pseudocode: in cmd/agentkit-tools/index_test.go: r1 = parse(run(call code_search with --index-dir X).stdout); m1 = stat and read X's manifest and shards; r2 = parse(run(the same).stdout); assert r1.ok and r2.ok and files(r1) == files(r2); assert X's manifest and shards equal m1

execution_paths.title: A change made in a session is seen by a later single call

steps.action: starts `agentkit-tools mcp --dir <checkout> --index-dir <dir>`, calls code_search, then edit_file to add fresh_marker to b.go, and closes the session
builds and stores the index on the first search, and exits 0 when the session closes
runs `agentkit-tools call` for code_search of fresh_marker with the same --dir and --index-dir
loads the stored index, revalidates, and returns b.go

real_components: the agentkit-tools binary in mcp mode and in call mode
the MCP Go SDK client over CommandTransport
setup: a temporary checkout of a few Go files and an empty index directory outside it
end_state: the session's code_search found needle and its process exited 0
the later single call's result is ok: true and names b.go for fresh_marker
the stored manifest is the one the session's build wrote: the single call did not rebuild
smoke.pseudocode: in cmd/agentkit-tools/index_test.go: cs = client over CommandTransport(bin mcp --dir D --index-dir X); cs.CallTool(code_search 'needle'); cs.CallTool(edit_file add fresh_marker to b.go); cs.Close(); m = read X's manifest; res = parse(run(['call','--dir',D,'--index-dir',X,'--request',R(code_search 'fresh_marker')]).stdout); assert res.ok and 'b.go' in res.text; assert X's manifest == m

execution_paths.title: Two single calls start at once on a fresh index directory

steps.action: starts two `agentkit-tools call` processes for code_search at the same moment, with the same --dir and --index-dir
in one process takes the lock, builds and stores the index; in the other waits for the lock and loads it

setup: a temporary checkout and an empty index directory outside it; skipped on Windows and where codesearch.New returns ErrUnsupported
end_state: both processes exit 0 with ok: true and the same files
the per-workspace directory holds exactly one stored index with its manifest and no temporary name
smoke.pseudocode: in cmd/agentkit-tools/index_test.go: start p1 and p2 = run(call code_search --index-dir X) without waiting; wait both; assert both exit 0 and their results' files are equal; assert X's per-workspace directory lists one manifest and no temporary entry

execution_paths.title: A maintainer checks the change and reads its docs

steps.action: runs `make check` and `make doc` at the repository root
runs fmt, vet, lint and the short tests in every module MODULES lists, codesearch and cmd/agentkit-tools among them, and writes the generated docs
reads docs/codesearch.md, docs/configuration.md, docs/cli.md and docs/guide.md for the stored index, IndexDir, --index-dir and AGENTKIT_INDEX_DIR

setup: a checkout of the branch; provider credentials scrubbed from the environment (env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY)
end_state: `make doc` leaves `git status --porcelain` empty and docs/generated/codesearch documents Options.IndexDir
docs/codesearch.md, docs/configuration.md, docs/cli.md and docs/guide.md each name what REQ-6.1 lists, and their Contents links resolve
